replacesBuiltin.note: When an overlay is loaded, skip LevelLoader._placeSagebrush (this overlay already places sagebrush_clump where it belongs).

roadStyle.note: Dusty, more cracks/potholes, leaf litter in gutters; lines faded.

env_sidewalk_curb_strip.convention: curb face at local x=0, road on -x, sidewalk to +x (1.68 m), 1.5 m along z; rotY 0 sidewalk +x, pi sidewalk -x, pi/2 sidewalk -z, -pi/2 sidewalk +z

env_sidewalk_curb_corner.convention: 3 m curb arc about the local origin; origin = curb-line intersection P + 3 m toward the block on both axes; straight runs trimmed to start 3 m from P

env_road_tile_4m.convention: 4x4 m; lift=1 tiles overlap a neighbour to cover odd-width leftovers: draw them +4 mm

decals.note: sizes are metres (atlas frame size x jitter); with registry makeEnvDecals: setFrameAt(i, frame) then compose your own matrix with scale (sizeX, 1, sizeZ)

jitter.note: any rotation works (it is a ball)

env_tuft_cards.note: scale already includes the frame scale (thistle 1.4, frostgrass 0.75, weeds 1.05)

rules.canopy: trees: canopyR = radiusXZ x scale must stay >= solidPathHalfWidthM from every path, >= doorClearM from doors, >= 0.3 m from walls/building masses, and leave half its radius off loot/interactives; solid bushes: the same for paths and doors

lod.trees: full mesh to 48 m, optional 2-tri billboard beyond, hidden past cullM (fog hides the pop)
lod.tufts: env_tuft_cards: compact visible instances into the front of the InstancedMesh every ~0.25 s (mesh.count = n)
lod.decals: static; single InstancedMesh (makeEnvDecals), frustumCulled=false, fog does the rest
